title: BAAP
body:
BAAP
Din dhale jab karke mazdoori Raza aata hai Baap..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh kar hanste hue bachon ko sukh pata hai baap
Samne Ankhon k jis bete ke mar jata hai baap
<<DIVIDER>>
Lamha lamha zindagi bhar usko yaad ata hai baap
Jane kitne khwab karte hain safar bache ke sath
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar se pehli bar jab school le jata hai baap
Umar bhar rehti hai us bete ke dil me ik khalish
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab tarakki dekhne se pehle mar jata hai baap
Thaam kar ungli jise chalna sikhaya muddaton
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek din uske sahare ko taras jata hai baap
Jab numaya kamiyabi chume bete ke qadam
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazr dilwati hai maa, sajde me gir jata hai baap
Zindagi bhar chalta rehta hai mashinon ki tarah
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut ki godi me ek din thak k sojata hai baap
Rote rote bus yahi kehta hai wo haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab kabhi apne jawan bete ko dafnata hai baap
Koi un bachon se puche kya hai shadi ka maza
<<DIVIDER>>
Byaah ki tareekh rakh kar jinki mar jata hai baap
Roz e ashura bana deti hai maa saqqa hume
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek chota sa uthane ko Alam lata hai baap
Roke zainab s.a ne kaha baba bhara ghar lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab shabe sham e garibaan me nazar aata hai baap
Kya kahunga haal e Asghar poch bethe jo rubab
<<DIVIDER>>
Agey jata hai kbhi peeche palat aata hai baap
Mangne aati hai jab darbaar me baag e fidak
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghamzada beti ko jane kitna yad ata hai baap
Hone hi wali hai is sham e garibaan ki sehar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazuon ko choom kar beti ko samjhata hai baap
Qaid khane me hua kohraam bacchi mar gai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuwab me ek shab sakeena ko nazar aata hai baap
Ye azadari ka sadqa hai jo barzakh me Raza
<<DIVIDER>>
Majlison me rote hain hum or jaza pata hai baap..
author: Shadman Raza
